instruction.text: The hexagon on the graph is to be moved 2 squares to the right. Drag the hexagon at the bottom to the position where the hexagon would be after the translation.
What are the coordinates of the hexagon’s start and end positions?
The triangle on the graph is to be moved down by 6 squares. Drag the triangle at the bottom to the position where the triangle would be after the translation.
What are the coordinates of the triangle’s start and end positions?
The circle on the graph is to be moved 5 squares to the right and up by 3 squares. Drag the circle at the bottom to the position where the circle would be after the translation.
What are the coordinates of the circle’s start and end positions?
The square on the graph is to be moved 1 squares to the right and down by 4 squares. Drag the square at the bottom to the position where the square would be after the translation.
What are the coordinates of the square’s start and end positions?
